events.title: Novartis Q3 Profit Declines; Lifts FY26 Core Income View, Backs Sales Outlook
events.description: Swiss drug major Novartis AG (NVS, NOVN.SW) reported Tuesday sharply lower profit in its third quarter, mainly hurt by an impairment charge and higher expenses, despite growth in net sales. Further, the firm raised fiscal 2026 outlook for core operating income and confirmed sales growth view.

events.title: European Shares Seen Tad Lower Ahead Of Tech Earnings, Rate Decisions
events.description: European stocks are seen opening a tad lower on Tuesday as investors await earnings from major U.S. technology companies and the Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision for direction.

events.title: Indian Shares Marginally Lower In Early Trade; IT Stocks Underperform
events.description: Indian shares were moving lower in early trade on Tuesday as investors awaited earnings from major U.S. technology companies and the Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision for direction.

events.title: Australian Market Swings To Modest Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is swinging to modest gains in mid-market trading on Tuesday, extending the slight gains in the previous two sessions, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is moving above the 8,700 level, with gains across most sectors led by mining and financial stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mixed
events.description: Asian stock markets are mixed on Tuesday, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, amid easing crude oil prices on optimism over the resolution of the Middle East conflict following reports of a delegation from Qatar has visited Iran to discuss de-escalation of regional conflicts. Some traders also looked to pick up stocks at relatively reduced levels after the recent slump.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Opening On Flat Note
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening on a flat note on Tuesday as global bond yields stabilized and oil prices pulled back from recent highs amid hopes for regional diplomacy in the Middle East.

events.title: Thai Stock Market May Challenge Resistance At 1,600 Points
events.description: The Thai stock market has moved higher in three straight sessions, climbing almost 25 points or 1.4 percent in that span. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just beneath the 1,580-point plateau and it's expected to open to the upside again on Tuesday.

events.title: Japanese Market Sharply Higher
events.description: The Japanese stock market is trading sharply higher on Tuesday, snapping a three-session losing streak, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, with the Nikkei 225 moving above the 63,650 level, with gains in index heavyweights and technology stocks.

events.title: Higher Open Tipped For Indonesia Stock Market
events.description: The Indonesia stock market on Monday ended the four-day winning streak in which it had jumped almost 450 points or 8.6 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just beneath the 5,375-point plateau although it's expected to open in the green on Tuesday.

events.title: Continued Strength Predicted For Hong Kong Stock Market
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market has moved higher in consecutive trading days, gathering more than 275 points or 1.2 percent along the way. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 23,210-point plateau may extend its gains on Tuesday.

events.title: Australian Markets Modestly Lower
events.description: The Australian stock market is modestly lower on Tuesday, reversing the slight gains in the previous two sessions, despite the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling below the 8,800 level, as traders remain cautious ahead of the release of inflation data tomorrow, which will have an impact on the outlook for interest rates.

events.title: Win Streak May Continue For China Stock Market
events.description: The China stock market has moved higher in back-to-back sessions, collecting almost 40 points or 1.1 percent in that span. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just beneath the 3,700-point plateau and it may add to its winnings on Tuesday.

events.title: Taiwan Stock Market Due For Support On Tuesday
events.description: Ahead of the long break on Friday (Typhoon Champi) and Monday (Restoration Day), the Taiwan stock market headed south again on Thursday, one day after ending the two-day losing streak in which it had given up almost 820 points or 1.7 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 46,040-point plateau although it's expected to open to the upside on Tuesday.
